movement: A.5 changed from open for general X to proved for all X with an explicit degree bound.
C.1 changed from open essential-image classification to an exact necessary and sufficient closed/formal/overlap/chart criterion on every locally noetherian base.
A.4 has no remaining projective-space cases, and the determinant image is exact for arbitrary X. The remaining gate is the nonabelian image and irreducibility for arbitrary X.
B.4 changed from an unbounded existence question to the sharp least index between explicit finite universal upper and constructive lower bounds.
E.2 now excludes F-pure finite-type perfect-field bases from the unresolved arbitrary-module gate.

open_rows.gate: All degrees proved for smooth global complete intersections and W2-liftable X of dimension at most p; explicit high-degree bounds for every X. Small degree outside these ranges remains.

open_rows.status: OPEN: ordinarity refuted; positivity and effective rank computation proved
open_rows.gate: Eventual positivity and the generic Hodge parenthesis have explicit bounds. A finite exact matrix algorithm determines each specified finite-field generic rank. A uniform structural rank formula for arbitrary X remains; the characteristic-two alpha4 surface refutes relative ordinarity.

open_rows.status: OPEN: all projective spaces and all determinant images determined
open_rows.gate: Every projective-space degree and characteristic is classified, geometrically and arithmetically. General geometric and arithmetic determinant images are exact Kummer images computable from the stable Hasse determinant. An explicit characteristic-two adjunction-square bound produces a fixed covector on every smooth section. The complete nonabelian image and irreducibility classification for arbitrary ambient X remain.

open_rows.status: OPEN: all tame elliptic levels and unrestricted cyclotomic bound determined
open_rows.gate: Exact tame higher-level criterion and least good-forcing level proved. Full p^n torsion forces mu_(p^n) for every abelian variety. Wild p=3 higher levels and potentially good higher-dimensional sharp bounds remain.

open_rows.status: OPEN: finite explicit upper and lower bounds proved
open_rows.gate: A finite universal truncation bound is proved in every height and every prime. Height1 has least index0. For every h>=2 and admissible e, M(0) fails to determine the prime-to-p character; higher lower bounds are explicit. The least index between the bounds remains.

open_rows.status: OPEN: coherent characteristic-zero and F-pure positive-characteristic cases proved
open_rows.gate: Every quasi-coherent infinitesimal crystal over a finite-type perfect-field scheme is F-divided. For F-pure such schemes, arbitrary quasi-coherent stratifications and crystals agree. The general flat relative assertion, including arbitrary sheaves, remains. The manuscript itself inserts a coherent locally noetherian qualification.
